author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Seventy-One! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

MEAT is a One Page Rulebook game of Survival Horro in a rotting cabin in the woods. Arriving to try to discover the fate of your friend, an old Academic, MEAT puts you in the role of an investigator trying to survive night after night of hungry dead. Love I am Legend or Evil Dead? Alone in the Dark? This game is probably for you. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules HERE : https://sablebadger.itch.io/cold-salvage-core
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 071 - MEAT by Ill Gotten Games
